description: Known zero bits of a sparse multiplication lost: ((x & 12) * 17) & 48 not folded to 0
still_missed_on: clang trunk (godbolt, -march=skylake), 2026-10-27: missed in the IR, but llc recovers it
notes: C translated from the issue's known_zero_bits reproducer. Same KnownBits::mul family as #227280 (power-of-two-or-zero factor), added separately as llvm-issue-227280. The miss is real in the IR, but llc already recovers it: the issue's form `ret i32 0` is proven correct (refinement) by Alive2 and gives the same llvm-mca cycles on Skylake as the source (measured by Benoit with the reference toolchain, 2026-10-28). No assembly gain, so it is an A entry (moved from B, 2026-10-29).
